description.zh:
网络访问限制策略。

JSON 格式字符串，具体参见AccessKeyPolicy结构说明。
description.en:
The network access restriction policy.

A JSON-formatted string. For more information, see the AccessKeyPolicy structure description.

description.zh:
RAM 用户的登录名称。 

如果为空，默认为当前用户的指定访问密钥设置网络访问限制策略。
description.en:
The logon name of the RAM user. 

If this parameter is left empty, the network access restriction policy is set for the specified AccessKey pair of the current user by default.

title.zh: 设置指定访问密钥的网络访问限制策略
title.en: Set the network access restriction policy for a specified accessKey pair

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ims set-access-key-policy --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --user-access-key-id LTAI0000000000000000000 --access-key-policy Status_:_Inactive_,_Statements_:_Value_:_AllowAllVPC_,_Type_:_VPCWhiteList_,_IPList_:_::/0_,_0.0.0.0/0 --region cn-hangzhou
